title: geocode_address inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the analysis/geoprocessing geocode tool (advertised name honua_geocode_address). Resolves a freeform address to ranked candidates. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

address.description: Freeform single-line address text to geocode.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of candidates to return.

countryCodes.description: Optional comma-separated ISO 3166 country codes to restrict the search.

outSrid.description: Spatial reference (SRID/WKID) for returned candidate coordinates.
